t01_dispatch: Target-projection dispatch in the independent RTX B/C1/C4 studies. All three paths begin after the same Q8\_1 activation preparation; counts refer to one examined MMVQ operation.
t02_qualification: Numerical qualification of the bound CUDA paths. These are original-machine complete-object checks; Table~\ref{tab:access} distinguishes the independently readable public subset.
t03_deployments: Deployment profiles for the principal studies. Context is C1024 except A5000 confirmation B (C4096). The artifact deployment register binds compiler, driver, placement and model identities.
t04_studies: Sampling and workloads by independent study. Inputs are prompt tokens or selected LOCAL history lengths; outputs are generated tokens or requested rows. Repeated rounds remain within their root and time block. NR denotes an unreported field in the earlier RTX normalized table.
t05_m1: M1 factorial: 16 roots and four sessions per root, with 64 measured requests per cell. Each projection row reports native-service totals and its direct LOCAL/WHOLE time reduction. Intervals are 99\% marginal members of the five-comparison Bonferroni family; Table~\ref{tab:m1-family} retains the complete family.
t07_confirmation_natural: Natural 8B target-only confirmation: effects and individual 95\% whole-time-block intervals over two fixed conversations and 12 paired blocks. The primary estimate weights conversations equally within each block. All block values and direction counts remain in Section~\ref{supp:confirmation}.
t06_neighbors: Reference selection, retained execution freedom, and state handoff in the closest systems.
s01_local_pairs: Every original LOCAL pair, including successors from each arm's own committed state.
s02_diagnostics: Independent device-event diagnostics for the two first-transaction histories. Times and counts use the profiler's own clock.
s14_confirmation_effects: All six A5000 confirmation endpoints and their prespecified roles. The interaction is a ratio of ratios.
s15_confirmation_A: Every 32B confirmation pair: first-transaction verification-through-commit milliseconds. Noncrossing is primary and crossing supporting.
s16_confirmation_B: Every 8B confirmation pair: complete two-turn response-plus-reset seconds. C0/C1 identify conversations in this panel.
s17_confirmation_costs: Arithmetic mean LOCAL-minus-SIMPLE phase differences in milliseconds within the registered response-plus-reset clock.
s18_rtx269_effects: RTX confirmation primary and descriptive complete-request estimates, with crossed root/time-block intervals.
s19_rtx269_blocks: All six RTX time blocks in execution order: within-block geometric time ratios.
s20_rtx269_roots: All 24 RTX roots: per-root geometric time ratios over 12 rounds.
s21_rtx269_phases: RTX confirmation arithmetic phase differences, candidate minus control, within the complete resident-request clock.
s11_direct_effects: All direct modern request effects, retaining each independent study and its contemporaneous control.
s03_phase_costs: Signed arithmetic mean phase differences in milliseconds. Each column is one same-study SD/SD comparison.
s06_m1_family: M1's five-comparison family. Direct contrasts use ratios of totals; interaction uses root-geometric ratios.
s07_m1_roots: Every M1 paired root. Times sum four sessions in seconds; each row gives its direct cut-policy ratios.
s05_natural: Other historical natural LOCAL/WHOLE panels with their original units, clocks and estimators.
s04_ledger: Request-role accounting. Timing-table scope and full-campaign completion are distinct.
s08_access: Numerical evidence scope: original-machine comparisons and the independently readable saved-object subset.
s09_pilot: The separate B570 draft-placement pilot: two roots, one round and a predeclared complete-service stop.
s12_historical_geometry: Earlier Vulkan geometry observations, including slower LOCAL cells and their original fixed-cell summaries.
s13_historical_applications: Historical resident effects and the separate worker lifetime. Fastest resident and worker controls are selected within their own measured configurations.
